title: Correct Coulomb force
description: Essential: Student provides the correct magnitude of the electrostatic force (6.4 × 10⁻⁶ N).

title: Correct electric field (with q)
description: Essential: Student provides the correct magnitude of the electric field at point B with q present (4.0 × 10³ N/C).

title: Correct electric field (without q)
description: Essential: Student states the electric field magnitude remains 4.0 × 10³ N/C after removing q.

title: Applies Coulomb's Law
description: Important: Student uses the formula F = k|Qq|/r² to calculate the force.

title: Defines electric field correctly
description: Important: Student uses E = F/q or E = kQ/r² to find the field at point B.

title: Understands field independence
description: Important: Student recognizes the electric field at a point is determined by the source charge Q, not the test charge q.

title: Unit analysis or conversion
description: Optional: Student shows consistent unit handling or dimensional analysis in calculations.

title: Sign or direction confusion
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly uses signs for force or field magnitude, or confuses vector/scalar quantities.

title: Incorrect distance or formula
description: Pitfall: Student uses wrong distance (e.g., r instead of r²) or misapplies the electric field formula (e.g., E = F/Q).
